node.text:
I have two boys with ADHD and personally, I’ve seen how much their behaviour, focus and mood shift depending on what they eat, how they sleep, and how supported their bodies actually are. It’s not perfect and honestly, it’s impossible for them to eat like this all the time. Life happens, parties happen, school happens. But what I’ve realised is that having an influence on what they eat at home can make the world of difference. When we focus on real food, enough protein, minerals like magnesium and iron, probiotics for gut health (remember the gut-brain axis), healthy fats which feed the brain and help manage blood sugar, and getting them to wind down properly at night (which is a mission on its own 😅), things feel calmer and more manageable. I’m not saying this replaces anything or works overnight, but small changes at home really do add up more than you think.
